manifest.final_checkpoint_selection: Final fixed exposure endpoint; no best-checkpoint selection or formal-test tuning.

pilot.selection: Prespecified primary eta .001 if numerical finiteness and exact resume pass; .0001 pilot stability sensitivity only; no task-score selection. Gate passed.

exploratory_prior_diagnosis.use: Mechanism diagnosis of previous frozen checkpoints; excluded from new formal estimates. V1 source preserved; additive V2 paired observer verified trajectory-identical.

128-step arms use512 Adam steps vs64-step1024; accum128 andbp128 share updatefrequency/forward/loss exposure and differ graphdetachment.

definitions.statistical_unit: one independently trained seed; sample SD, never request-level pseudo-replication
definitions.strict_completion: clean_completed / matured primary requests; right-censored requests excluded
definitions.own_state_content: existing 8-FINISH argmax on active primary opportunities; opportunities are policy-dependent and may include not-yet-matured requests
definitions.first_legal_content: first observed legal opportunity per matured primary request with such an opportunity
definitions.matched_loss_given_cue_correct: lost / (both_correct + lost), on matured requests with both observed cue and first legal readout; no-cue/no-legal/neither counts remain separate. Existing-head readability, not full encoding information.
definitions.inactive_rates: same inactive-action numerator, per1000 idle enabled-slot opportunities and per1000 all enabled-slot opportunities separately
definitions.diagnostic_deltas: intervention minus matched baseline; counterfactual trajectories, never autonomous controller scores
definitions.coverage_comparisons: paired by training seed/origin, but training distribution and event/cohort exposures differ
definitions.pure_coactivity: no label-based updates during this continuation; inherits supervised initial weights; unequal information to BP
definitions.storage: derived old-bank tensor bytes assume float32 observations/states and int64 targets; metadata/optimizer/autograd storage excluded
definitions.update_norms: BP uses realized post-Adam parameter differences. Local delta norms describe the additive float32 update before addition-rounding; call counts and norms do not imply matched FLOPs.
definitions.trace: live EMA persists across chunks/resume; historical zero-start plus64tick burn-in is approximate, not derivative eligibility
